title: Item Components Wearable
description: Sets the wearable item component, which allows an item to be worn by a player in a specified equipment slot.

slot.title: Equipment Slot
slot.description:
Specifies where the item can be worn. If any non-hand slot is chosen, the max stack size is set to 1.

Sample values:
• chestplate: slot.armor.chest
• crown: slot.armor.head
• my_boots: slot.armor.feet

hides_player_location.title: Hides Player Location
hides_player_location.description: Determines whether the Player's location is hidden on Locator Maps and the Locator Bar when the wearable item is worn. Default is false.

protection.title: Protection
protection.description: How much protection the wearable item provides. Default is set to 0.
